Title: Wonder Woman Vol 5 7

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5_7

Published Time: Thu, 27 Feb 2025 22:03:20 GMT

Markdown Content:
****_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5) #7**** is an issue of the series [_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5 "Wonder Woman Vol 5") with a cover date of [November, 2016](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2016,_November "Category:2016, November"). It was published on September 28, 2016.

## Synopsis for "[The Lies](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman:_The_Lies "Wonder Woman: The Lies"), Part Four"

[Wonder Woman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Diana_of_Themyscira_(Prime_Earth) "Diana of Themyscira (Prime Earth)") and [Cheetah](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Barbara_Minerva_(Prime_Earth) "Barbara Minerva (Prime Earth)") reach [Cadulo](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Andres_Cadulo_(Prime_Earth) "Andres Cadulo (Prime Earth)")'s prison, freeing almost all the women he abducted and also [Steve](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Steve_Trevor_(Prime_Earth) "Steve Trevor (Prime Earth)")'s team, who debrief Diana about what's happening, including the fact that Trevor has been chosen as the vessel for [Urzkartaga](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Urzkartaga_(Prime_Earth) "Urzkartaga (Prime Earth)"). After telling them to lead the prisoners to safety and assuring them Cheetah can be trusted, the soldiers follow Wonder Woman's order while the Amazon and Cheetah prepare for a confrontation with the evil god himself. While getting to the ritual's site, Diana asks Barbara Ann about the role of women in Urzkartaga's existence, and Wonder Woman then tells Cheetah she has an hypothesis, and that probably she was deceived as much as Diana herself.

Approaching Cadulo, who just initiated the rite, Wonder Woman starts the fight with the demonic Urzkartaga, ready to take flesh. The evil god promises to her cursed bride, Cheetah, that if she takes the life of Diana she will be free from her curse, but Diana tells her to resist his proposal: she understood that Urzkartaga does not imprison women for lust, but for fear. They are their custodians, the only creatures able to bound him and restrain him: giving to Barbara Ann and the remaining prisoners the [Lasso of Truth](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Lasso_of_Truth "Lasso of Truth"), the group of women prove Diana's theory right, banishing Urzkartaga from the place. As the evil god is defeated, the curse of Cheetah is lifted and Barbara Ann, human again, cries both in joy and frustration, understanding she was deceived for the whole time.

## Appearing in "[The Lies](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman:_The_Lies "Wonder Woman: The Lies"), Part Four"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Wonder Woman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Diana_of_Themyscira_(Prime_Earth) "Diana of Themyscira (Prime Earth)")

## Notes

*   The "_Lies_" storyline is continued in [_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5) #9](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5_9 "Wonder Woman Vol 5 9").
